title: Carousel directive
description: Apply to a container whose direct element children are slides. No clones or content replacement.
integration: Import the standalone CarouselDirective from `@arcwell/ui` and add it to the consuming Angular component’s `imports`.
Configure inputs with Angular bindings for booleans, numbers, arrays and objects. Do not turn signal-backed inputs into method calls in consumer templates.
Consult the linked story before copying a render recipe: its moduleMetadata imports, helper constants, form setup and custom props may be required.

configuration.label: DlCarouselFalse

configuration.label: Index

configuration.label: Breakpoints
configuration.description: Demonstrates the breakpoints setting on this carousel directive.

configuration.label: Gap
configuration.description: Changes the space between children. Here it is set to “24”.

configuration.label: Width
configuration.description: Sets an explicit width. Here it is set to “600px”.

configuration.description: Sets an explicit height. Here it is set to “400px”.

configuration.label: OrientationHorizontal
configuration.description: Switches between horizontal and vertical arrangements. Here it is set to “horizontal”.

configuration.label: OrientationVertical
configuration.description: Switches between horizontal and vertical arrangements. Here it is set to “vertical”.

configuration.label: Step
configuration.description: Changes the amount added or removed by each step. Here it is set to “2”.
